en.title: Delivery Management System (QR Intern)
en.description:
Cities and two-way roads form an unweighted graph. Starting from the city where the factory is located, deliver in ascending order of shortest-path distance; ties in distance are broken by ascending city number. Unreachable cities are not output, and neither is the start city itself.

See the statement/review record for the problem source and the basis of the rules; limits marked in the input ranges are supplements added by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n, m and company (cities are numbered 1..n); each of the next m lines contains a two-way road u v. Site-added ranges: 1≤n≤100000, 0≤m≤200000; the graph has no self-loops and no duplicate edges.
en.output: Output the visited city numbers on one line, separated by spaces. If no other city is reachable, output an empty line.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the problem rules; see the companion notes for the full approach, the correctness argument and the complexity.
hints: Run BFS from the factory city to get the shortest distance in edges to every reachable city, then sort by (distance, number) and output.
